text: @406464/dsh-db 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 SQLite 数据库工作台。它通过 Web 面板和 Agent 的 db 工具接入，并可选注册 storage hub 的 SQLite 后端。主要功能包括管理数据库连接、查看表结构、执行 SQL 查询、分页筛选和编辑数据，以及导出 CSV 或 JSON。适合需要在 DSH 中查看和维护本地 SQLite 数据库、或让其他插件使用 SQLite 存储的用户。运行需要 DSH 提供 Node.js 内置 node:sqlite；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

@406464/dsh-db is a SQLite workbench for DSH. A web panel and agent tool manage connections, inspect schemas, query and edit rows, and export CSV or JSON. It can also register SQLite for the storage hub. It uses Node.js node:sqlite and requires no API key or external service.

@406464/dsh-db 的功能「Agent 数据库工具」：通过 db 工具列出连接、查看结构、查询或导出数据。调用时选择 action 并提供连接及 SQL 等参数。
@406464/dsh-db 的功能「SQLite 查询」：可对已登记连接执行带位置参数的 SQL，并限制结果行数。用户通过面板或 Agent 工具提交查询，得到列、行和截断状态。
@406464/dsh-db 的功能「数据网格」：按表查看记录，支持过滤、排序和分页，并可插入、编辑或删除行。编辑操作通过面板调用相应 API。
@406464/dsh-db 的功能「存储后端」：将 SQLite 注册为 storage hub 后端，其他插件可按存储域使用。插件启用该选项并由 storage 服务注入时完成注册。

A database workbench plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): SQLite connection manager + SQL editor + data-grid panel + an agent-facing `db` tool — plus the **sqlite backend** that DSH's storage hub documents but does not ship.

@406464/dsh-db README · dsh-db：Built on Node's built-in `node:sqlite` (`DatabaseSync`): **no native dependencies, no build step, no Electron ABI roulette**.

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

@406464/dsh-db README · What you get：| Surface | Contents |
|---|---|
| **Panel** | A "Database" icon in the left sidebar → full-page workbench: connections, table tree, SQL editor, paginated/sortable/filterable data grid, inline cell editing, CSV/JSON export |
| **Agent tool** | One `db` tool with an `action` parameter, so the agent in a session can inspect and query your databases |
| **Storage backend** | Registers as backend `sqlite` on `ctx.storage`, so other plugins can route their `ctx.storageDomain` domains to SQLite |
@406464/dsh-db README · What you get：Panel actions and agent tools call the **same** host methods. One operation, two callers.

@406464/dsh-db README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/406464/dsh-db.git
cd dsh-db && npm install && npm test     # self-test, no DSH required
```

Then install it into DSH — `dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm in the profile directory:

```powershell

@406464/dsh-db README · macOS desktop：DSH_CLI="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh"
"$DSH_CLI" plugin --profile desktop add @406464/dsh-db
```

Until the npm release lands, install straight from GitHub:

```bash
"$DSH_CLI" plugin --profile desktop add github:406464/dsh-db
```

Or install from a local directory via the Plugins page, or ask the agent to run `install_bundle` on the cloned folder.
@406464/dsh-db README · macOS desktop：**Restart DSH afterwards**: host-side modules load once at startup. If the sidebar entry is missing, check that the bundle is enabled on the Plugins page.

@406464/dsh-db README · Safety defaults：- **Only registered connections.** A path must sit inside an allowed root (plugin data dir + workspaces + `allowDirs`). Unregistered files are unreachable.
- **Two gates for writes.** `allowWrite` plus an explicit `confirm: true` per call.
- **Statement guard.** Unrecognised leading keywords are rejected; `ATTACH`/`DETACH` off by default; `load_extension` always rejected.
- **Bounded results.** Row-count and byte caps, with `truncated: true` instead of dumping a table into the model context.
- **Loopback-only HTTP.** `/dsh-db/api/*` accepts local requests and POST only.
@406464/dsh-db README · Safety defaults：Errors carry stable codes: `write-disabled`, `confirm-required`, `forbidden-sql`, `path-out-of-scope`, `multi-statement`, `not-found`, `sql-error`.

@406464/dsh-db README · How this differs from similar plugins：[`dsh-db-studio`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-db-studio) already exists on npm (SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL, with an in-conversation database tab, a `/db` command, and query history). Different tradeoffs:
section: How this differs from similar plugins

text:
@406464/dsh-db README · How this differs from similar plugins：| | dsh-db (this project) | dsh-db-studio |
|---|---|---|
| Databases | SQLite only | SQLite + PG + MySQL |
| Dependencies | **zero** (Node's built-in `node:sqlite`) | `pg` + `mysql2` |
| storage-hub sqlite backend | **yes** — other plugins can route domains to SQLite | no |
| In-conversation binding / query history / `/db` | no | yes |
| Writes by default | **off** (`allowWrite: false` + per-call `confirm`) | on |
